packageRules.description: One pull request for the GitHub Actions in the workflows
The docs site's minor and patch updates together; majors on their own
LLVM: its archives' SHA-256s in scripts/get_llvm.*, the version the compiler reports and the clang that builds Rig change with it, so an update waits for approval on the dashboard
prBodyNotes:
**This pull request isn't complete as Renovate opens it.** Renovate changes only `VERSION=` in `scripts/get_llvm.sh` and `scripts/get_llvm.bat`. The release is also the compiler that builds Rig: `get_llvm` keeps its clang, which `build.sh` and `build.bat` use, so this changes the clang every build, CI's and the release's included, is made with, and the debug and release builds both have to pass on it. Before it can merge:

- [ ] Download both archives of the new release (`LLVM-{{{newVersion}}}-Linux-X64.tar.xz` and `clang+llvm-{{{newVersion}}}-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.xz`), and put their SHA-256s in `SHA256=` of each script.
- [ ] Update the LLVM cache keys: `llvm-{{{currentVersion}}}-linux` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/release.yml`, and `llvm-{{{currentVersion}}}-windows` in `release.yml`.
- [ ] Update what names the LLVM version: `git grep -n "{{{currentVersion}}}" -- . ":!deps" ":!docs/superpowers"` (CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, docs/rig-spec.md's `rig version` and debug producer strings, any test that pins them).
- [ ] Copy `llvm/LICENSE.TXT` and `lld/LICENSE.TXT` of llvm-project at `llvmorg-{{{newVersion}}}` into `third_party/llvm/` and `third_party/lld/`, byte for byte, and change the tag in `third_party/README.md`: the release archives ship them.
- [ ] Run `get_llvm`, build, and run `bin/unit-tests` and `bin/run-tests` (with `RIG_DEBUGGER_TESTS=required`) on Windows and Linux, for a debug build and a release build (`build.bat release`, `./build.sh release`), each with no warnings from the new clang.
- [ ] Afterwards, run `get_llvm` again in each checkout, so its `deps/` holds the new release.
